name: toolbar
gotchas: mat-toolbar is a layout/styling wrapper only — the toggle behavior in a typical app shell comes from a button inside the toolbar calling `MatSidenav.toggle()`, not from the toolbar itself.

Multiple `mat-toolbar-row` children inside one `mat-toolbar` stack vertically and each still spans the toolbar's fixed row height — content that needs to wrap onto multiple lines needs a taller custom row, not additional `mat-toolbar-row`s.

A toolbar fixed to the top of the viewport (via your own `position: fixed` styling — MatToolbar doesn't do this for you) needs the page content below it manually offset by the toolbar's height, or content renders underneath it.
